stories.title: Implement issuer 10-Q XBRL extraction slice
acceptanceCriteria: Registry constrains total_revenue, operating_income, and net_income to issuer-route 10-Q XBRL-only extraction in src/pipeline/extraction/registry.py.

NumericExtractionEngine selects the best XBRL fact for the three target fields using concept priority, statement type, dimensionless preference, and 10-Q quarter-duration filtering in src/pipeline/extraction/engine.py.
Successful numeric extraction returns replayable XBRL evidence including xbrl_concept, source_xpath, and source_span.
_build_bundles_from_provider in src/cli.py emits the implemented baseline issuer 10-Q/10-Q/A deterministic fields and preserves numeric XBRL evidence.
Issuer 10-Q filings with no extracted target fields log NO_TARGET_FIELDS_EXTRACTED and do not emit a populated extraction bundle.
XBRL query/runtime failures surface as XBRL_QUERY_FAILED rather than silently degrading to FIELD_NOT_FOUND.
The 10-Q numeric batch evaluator in src/pipeline/golden_10q_numeric_batch.py uses runtime-compatible candidate keys, alias handling, filtering, date coercion, and scoring heuristics for the slice.
Pytest passes for the relevant regression suite under tests/.
Ruff check passes for src/ and tests/.
compileall passes for src/ and tests/.

stories.title: Expand issuer 10-Q slice with additional deterministic document fields
acceptanceCriteria: Registry adds deterministic issuer-route 10-Q XBRL-only configs for diluted_eps, operating_cash_flow, cash_and_equivalents, capex, and shares_outstanding in src/pipeline/extraction/registry.py.
NumericExtractionEngine supports both duration-style and instant-style fact selection needed by those fields in src/pipeline/extraction/engine.py.
The engine prefers the correct current-period instant fact for cash_and_equivalents and shares_outstanding when multiple instant facts are present.
The engine supports quarter-aware preferred durations for operating_cash_flow and capex in 10-Q filings.
CLI bundle building for issuer 10-Q/10-Q/A emits all implemented deterministic fields and their XBRL evidence in src/cli.py.
Regression tests cover diluted_eps, operating_cash_flow, cash_and_equivalents, capex, and shares_outstanding selection behavior plus 10-Q/A bundle emission under tests/.
Pytest passes for tests/.
Ruff check passes for src/ and tests/.
compileall passes for src/ and tests/.

stories.title: Implement owner route Form 4 row-grain slice
acceptanceCriteria: Schema and persistence support row-grain facts/evidence via subject_key for owner-route multi-row filings.
Owner-route provider/build path supports deterministic Form 4 extraction using filing.obj().transactions.
Form 4 extraction emits transaction-row values for shares_acquired_or_disposed, transaction_price_per_share, and shares_owned_following_txn with stable subject_key values.
Multiple Form 4 transactions in a single filing persist without collisions.
Owner-route regression tests pass for persistence and Form 4 bundle construction.
Pytest passes for tests/.
Ruff check passes for src/ and tests/.
compileall passes for src/ and tests/.

stories.title: Expand owner route Form 4 with derivative transaction fields
acceptanceCriteria: Owner-route Form 4 extraction emits derivative_underlying_shares and exercise_or_conversion_price for derivative transaction rows.
Derivative rows use stable subject_key values distinct from non-derivative transaction rows.
Row-grain persistence supports the new derivative transaction facts/evidence without collisions.
Regression tests cover owner derivative transaction bundle emission.
Pytest passes for tests/.
Ruff check passes for src/ and tests/.
compileall passes for src/ and tests/.

stories.title: Expand owner route with holdings rows for Forms 3/4/5
acceptanceCriteria: Owner-route provider/build path supports deterministic holdings extraction for Forms 3, 4, and 5.
Owner holdings extraction emits non_derivative_shares_owned from non-derivative holdings rows with stable subject_key values.
Owner holdings extraction emits derivative_underlying_shares and exercise_or_conversion_price from derivative holdings rows with stable subject_key values.
Holding-row subject keys are distinct from transaction-row subject keys and persist without collisions.
Regression tests cover owner holdings bundle emission for a holdings-style filing.
Pytest passes for tests/.
Ruff check passes for src/ and tests/.
compileall passes for src/ and tests/.
